note: The apps this skill knows about, and what each one needs. This is the skill's own copy
so that a first question ('map this field for me') can be answered before anything is
installed; the app's own app.json, fetched beside its viewer, is the authoritative
word and overrides these entries. A discovery process that asks a server for available
apps replaces this file — not the commands that read it.

apps.title: Research field map
apps.purpose: Map a research field so it can be looked at: what the field is made of, who works on it, and where the applied work is.

tool_notes.openalex: works, authors, institutions and concepts in one place, free and without a key — it carries most of the skeleton
tool_notes.crossref: publisher metadata, DOIs and funders, for what OpenAlex has not indexed
tool_notes.arxiv: preprints, which appear here months before anywhere else
tool_notes.a web-search tool: the only way to evidence a company — no free API lists what a private company is working on

apps.level_note: where a kind sits on the fold axis when a node of that kind carries no `level` of its own. Whole numbers: the axis is one coordinate, and a node may stand anywhere between them — a sub-concept at 2.2, a satellite paper at 3.4, a researcher who matters more than the paper at 3.6. The document always wins.
